title: Starlight Dynamics Q4 Preliminary Unaudited Earnings Release

chunks.text: Starlight Dynamics (NASDAQ: STLD) today announced preliminary unaudited financial results for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2023. Total revenue was $62.5 billion, representing an 8% year-over-year increase. Operating expenses for Q4 were reported as $14.2 billion, resulting in an operating margin of 24.1% and a net margin of 22.4%. Chief Financial Officer Sarah Jenkins noted that operational efficiencies drove lower-than-anticipated administrative overhead.

title: Starlight Dynamics Form 10-K Audited Annual Report

chunks.section: Item 8 - Note 18: Restatement and Litigation Accrual
chunks.text: In the audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, filed March 15, 2024, Starlight Dynamics recognized a post-closing litigation settlement accrual of $1.6 billion related to intellectual property disputes. Consequently, fourth quarter operating expenses were revised and audited at $15.8 billion (an increase from the preliminary estimate of $14.2 billion), reducing fourth quarter operating margin to 21.5% and net margin to 19.8%. Full year net income was adjusted downward to $11.2 billion.
